mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( receiver_id, type, message, target_url ) VALUES ( #{receiverId}, #{type}, #{message}, #{targetUrl} )
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id, receiver_id, type, message, target_url, read_at, created_at FROM notification WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notification WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND read_at IS NOT NULL AND read_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id, receiver_id, type, message, target_url, read_at, created_at FROM notification WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND notification_id > #{lastEventId} ORDER BY notification_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET read_at = NOW() WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND read_at IS NULL
